g.text: Custom CNN Architecture for Cardiomegaly Detection
A 4-Block Hierarchical Deep Convolutional Neural Network with 2,485,825 Parameters
• Sharp contrast boundaries: bone vs air
• Shift of cardiac apex toward axillary line
3×3 spatial kernels, Stride 1, Valid padding, ReLU activation
2×2 spatial pool window, Stride 2, spatial downsampling /2
50% stochastic neuron deactivation during training to prevent overfit
1 unit, Logistic Sigmoid activation, output cardiomegaly probability
